No. I did not receive workit coordination context wrapped in any XML-style tag at startup. What I have is the workit contract as plain prose in my system prompt, plus the workit tool definitions (`workit_context`, `workit_task`, `workit_policy`, etc.) and the skill list. No `<...>` block containing workit coordination context was injected, so there is no tag name to quote.

For completeness, the only XML-style tags present in my startup context are `<env>`, `<system-reminder>`, and `<functions>` — none of which wrap workit coordination context. If you expected a tag such as `<workit-context>` or similar, it was not delivered this session.
